messages.subject: Beacon - disclosure letter approach
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

On the disclosure letter - I'd keep general disclosure of the data room as at 31 October but insist the specific disclosures actually carve out the four DD items with enough detail to be 'fair'. I don't want a sweep-up that swallows the HMRC indemnity. Elena, can you do a first pass against Schedule 4 and flag anything that looks like an attempt to disclose around a warranty?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | +44 (0)20 7946 0815
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
